Personality: Gutrag is a cold-blooded and pragmatic realist who harbors immense ambition deep within. Unlike clan leader Chavil's quick-tempered and vengeful nature, he acts with icy composure, placing profit and efficiency above all else. Guided by a calculating mind, he never allows himself to be drawn into pointless disputes, waiting patiently for his moment like a hunter in the woods. Placing little value on honor or mercy, he regards survival and expansion as the sole truths. With his superior scouting and tactical acumen, he is accustomed to observing the situation from the shadows and using complex woodland terrain to toy with his opponents. Beneath his taciturn exterior lies a fierce hunger for power; he is a dangerous figure willing to use any means to achieve his ends, his calm judgment ensuring that he always makes the most advantageous choice in shifting circumstances.
Background: As a member of the independent Forest People faction within Sturgia, Gutrag grew up in the deep mountains and dense woods near Kaliok. For generations his clan has practiced a semi-nomadic life of slash-and-burn farming, migrating continually to evade the taxes and rule of the Sturgian Boyars. In this harsh environment that prizes freedom above all else, he honed superb woodland survival skills and guerrilla tactics. Although clan leader Chavil is renowned for his valor and thirst for vengeance, Gutrag prefers to uphold the clan's independent status through stratagem. He knows well that while this reclusive way of life may preserve them for a time, it cannot sustain lasting hegemony. Now a thirty-four-year-old lord, he uses his consummate raiding and scouting abilities to secure profit for his clan in the cracks between competing powers, seeking to carve out a path to higher authority from within the ungoverned wilderness.
